blind.table_distance_name: stone wall with arrow slit window
blind.description: A thick, freestanding modular stone wall section featuring a cruciform arrow loop / embrasure window in the center. The exterior face shows flush masonry around the slit, while the interior face features deeply splayed/beveled stone jambs. The wall is topped with four rectangular coping stones. Textures feature yellowish-grey and weathered stone blocks with yellowish mortar and green moss/algae staining near the bottom. Surfaces are solid and continuous with no floating, shattered, or melted geometry.
blind.from_above: A long, narrow rectangular strip partitioned into four capstones with recessed joints, flanked by the cast shadow on the left and the scale figure on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: The wall is notably taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure, standing around 7.5 to 8 feet tall, and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide.
